questions.question: For what service were the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun set apart?
options: Offering the daily sacrifices at the altar of the LORD
Guarding the many gates of the sanctuary day and night
Keeping and managing the treasuries of the temple
Music and prophesying with lyres, harps, and cymbals
questions.answer: Music and prophesying with lyres, harps, and cymbals
